boundaries: OCR, table and formula recovery produce reviewable extraction candidates rather than verified source facts.
Complex merged tables, handwriting, cross-page tables and advanced formula layout still require source-page review.

Learning packs use approved teaching definitions and examples; they do not replace authored measurement items.
Completing tasks, watching whiteboards or using flashcards does not directly change mastery.
Only ICS compatibility is claimed; Canvas/Schoology native OAuth and two-way writeback remain out of scope.
